leadText: Paul's Magmortar (Japanese: シンジのブーバーン Shinji's Booburn) is a owned by Paul.
plainText:
Paul's Magmortar (Japanese: シンジのブーバーン Shinji's Booburn) is a owned by Paul.

==History==
 
Magmortar debuted in Lost Leader Strategy! as a where it appeared in a flashback. Reggie explained to that it easily defeated Maylene's with its and attacks, thus earning him the .

It made its physical debut in Aiding the Enemy!, resting with Paul's other Pokémon.

In A Pyramiding Rage!, Magmar was the first Pokémon chosen by Paul during his match against . He quickly recalled it after he saw Brandon chose to battle it. He sent it out again to battle . Registeel was able to shrug off Flamethrower with little difficulty and struck with , not causing much damage but making Magmar flinch and unable to use Will-O-Wisp. Paul recalled Magmar, but after all of Paul's other Pokémon were defeated, Paul sent out Magmar to once again battle Regirock, who easily tanked a Flamethrower attack and took Magmar out with .
 
In Pedal to the Mettle!, Magmar was revealed to have evolved into Magmortar when Paul chose it as his fifth Pokémon to battle Ash's Pikachu. They began the battle in Evolving Strategies!, where Pikachu got badly ed because of Magmortar's . Magmortar's powerful Flamethrower blocked Pikachu's , and then cleverly used to damage Pikachu during his . Magmortar used in an attempt to choke Pikachu but this was blocked by Counter Shield. However, Pikachu's attempt to follow up with did not cause nearly enough damage to Magmortar, and Ash recalled him for .

Despite the type disadvantage, Magmortar was able to hold its own, managing to carry on after a direct hit from . It used a wall of Rock Tombs to block , which turned out to be a distraction; while Buizel blasted through easily, Magmortar had vanished. It was revealed to have jumped into the air, landing a hit with Smog and poisoning Buizel. While Buizel choked, Paul recalled Magmortar. It wasn't used for the rest of the battle, but the burn it inflicted on Pikachu continued to affect him during a later battle against .

In Casting a Paul on Barry!, Magmortar was used in the battle against 's and it won with a single . Then, Magmortar fought against Barry's Empoleon, where it was shown to be strong enough to withstand Empoleon's . It was recalled by Paul, much to Barry's disappointment.

==Personality and characteristics==
Magmortar is considered to be one of Paul's trusted Pokémon in terms of strategies for his battles. Beginning in Evolving Strategies!, it had the ability to take in any attacks that was delivered including the ones that would have been super effective against Magmortar.

==Trivia==
Magmortar is the only Pokémon Paul has used against Ash that has never knocked out or been knocked out by any of Ash's Pokémon.
